# Declared Known Gaps & Baseline Trajectory Status

`FlexMESA` tracks all **106** end-to-end `test_suite` cases of **MESA release `26.4.1`** (`90` `star`, `8` `binary`, `8` `astero`; Zenodo record `19722306`). An upstream case counts as passing only when unmodified release inlists run uncapped in Rust `strict` mode to upstream's own termination code without in-library case overrides or pulsation scaffolding and match stored real-MESA history tracks within manifest tolerances (`notes/SCOPE.md`, `DECISIONS #17`, `DECISIONS #19`).

Instead of capping steps or loosening checks to force green runs, unfinished or diverging cases are declared in `benchmarks/history_harness/known_gaps.toml` with a linked tracking issue under `#140` (`#144`). CI fails on any undeclared failure and alerts if a declared gap starts passing so its entry can be promoted.

| Suite | Target Cases | Stored `26.4.1` Refs | `no_reference_yet` | Strict-Validated | Diagnostic Runs | Reach Upstream Term | Declared Gaps | Verified Pass |

| `astero` | 8 | 8 | 0 | 0 | 8 | 4 | 8 | 0 |
| **Total** | **106** | **102** | **4** | **0** | **106** | **41** | **102** | **0** |

`Strict-Validated` counts cases whose unmodified inlists pass strict control validation (`#147`). `Diagnostic Runs` counts cases that strict validation rejects and that were rerun with the unsupported controls ignored; their numbers show where the engine stands and can never count as a pass (`DECISIONS #26`). `Reach Upstream Term` counts runs of either kind.

- **Undeclared Failures**: `0`
- **Within Numeric Tolerance While Governed as Gaps**: `5` cases (`star/rsp_BEP` ([#148](https://github.com/joshspeagle/FlexMESA/issues/148)), `star/rsp_BLAP` ([#148](https://github.com/joshspeagle/FlexMESA/issues/148)), `star/rsp_Cepheid` ([#148](https://github.com/joshspeagle/FlexMESA/issues/148)), `star/rsp_RR_Lyrae` ([#148](https://github.com/joshspeagle/FlexMESA/issues/148)), `star/rsp_save_and_load_file` ([#148](https://github.com/joshspeagle/FlexMESA/issues/148))) meet numeric tolerances while remaining declared gaps under active tracking issues.

## Inspecting Known Gaps Programmatically

```python
from flexmesa.testing import case_manifest

manifest = case_manifest.load_case_manifest()
gaps = case_manifest.load_known_gaps()
assert len(manifest.cases) == 106
assert len(gaps) == 102
no_ref = [
    c.case for c in manifest.cases
    if c.reference_status == "no_reference_yet"
]
print(f"Manifest={len(manifest.cases)}, gaps={len(gaps)}, no_ref={len(no_ref)}")
```
